answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to stake collateral to validate transactions, acting as an onyx anchor of trust. By linking influence to capital, it creates a digital meadow where identity inflation is prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to subvert the system must acquire a majority of tokens, a task akin to harvesting a vast orchard, as the economic cost scales linearly with the number of nodes deployed, effectively pricing out fraudulent participation.
